instrument: funding-carry (top-N perpetuals, long spot + short perp, no leverage)
limitations: BASIS IS NOT MEASURED: perp prices per symbol are not in this dataset, so basisToday/basisYesterday are 0 and the return is funding-only. The measured E13 number charged the basis separately; treat the annualised figures here as an UPPER BOUND on the edge.
HISTORICAL, NOT OUT-OF-SAMPLE: every window is a description of the past. No forecast is made or implied.

CAPACITY IS A PROXY: funding is a rate and does not shrink with book size; the real limit is how much notional the chosen symbols absorb without moving the price. The proxy used is the edge gap between the top-N and the next 2N symbols.

headline.verdict: the edge is ALIVE: the most recent 12-month window is positive (17.86%/yr)

capacity.note: the gap between the top-N and the next symbols is the part of the edge that competition erodes first; a large gap means a larger book can be run before the edge thins
